analogy.rationale: JAK inhibitors block cytokine receptor signaling, but these cell lines express little JAK-dependent machinery and the transcriptional response is typically weak; other kinase inhibitors targeting related tyrosine kinases may show modest overlap, while BTK/SYK inhibitors act in similar hematopoietic pathways that are largely absent here.
